analysis.title: Market Rhythm Focus
key_insights: Equal-weight S&P 500 is printing fresh all-time highs on a decisive session and is reaccelerating within its uptrend, even though semis are in a bear phase and the Nasdaq remains in correction territory.
The Dow gapped higher with a strong candle, broke its downtrend and closed the prior bear gap. Momentum favors a retest of the summer highs, with key support at the Marubozu near 52,950.
The Russell 3000 reclaimed its 50dma and more stocks are trading above their 200dma. Rising breadth is usually supportive, though this year's profile is atypical versus history.

The Philadelphia Semiconductors index fell further below its 200dma and the July low, so it did not join the global risk-on move. Supports are thin and downside risk stays elevated, but the group looks oversold enough for a tactical bounce.

Brent broke the October uptrend, cut through the 50dma and the July uptrend, and quickly tagged the 200dma. Prices are near oversold, and 200dma support could encourage stabilization and consolidation.

US 10-year yields broke their uptrend. The desk notes recent correlations: pressure on the AI complex (semis, memory, neoclouds, Korea), while broader breadth and non-AI risk assets keep grinding higher.
KOSPI printed its lowest close in seven months and sits just above key 5,260 support. A third test usually breaks, opening downside, though the 5,000 area offers structural support.
TOPIX confirmed yesterday's hammer off the 200dma with another +1% session. Short-term momentum is turning up, and the 50dma near 4,066 is the first real resistance.
The Hang Seng cleared its 50dma with strong follow-through. It can now challenge the downtrend and the falling 200dma near 25,200-25,300, though some digestion of the gains is likely.

The Stoxx Europe 600 exited the mid-August downtrend, traded sideways for four sessions, then posted a solid bullish candle and nearly reached record levels. RSI is below overbought, so upside room remains.
The Swiss Market Index printed a new all-time high after a short pause. Momentum is stretched, so a pause looks likely even though the setup is positive.
The DAX moved sharply higher after consolidating around 26,000 and nearly retested its record. It appears to be targeting that high, with RSI below overbought.
The CAC 40 retook the 50dma and pushed up to the 200dma, closing just below it. The tone is positive after several days of recovery from the mid-August downtrend.
The FTSE MIB broke its downtrend and closed back above the 50dma. RSI is back above 50, supporting an emerging positive bias.
